extracted.name: 2-Ingredient Ice Cream
extracted.description: This 2-ingredient ice cream, made with whipped cream and sweetened condensed milk, is so easy to make and your family and friends will love it!
instruction_lines: Beat cream in a chilled glass or metal bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form; add condensed milk and beat until thick and well combined.
Transfer mixture to a shallow container and cover with plastic wrap; freeze until solid, about 6 hours.
